race.title: PricedUp Bet Handicap Chase
race.verdict: JUKEBOX D'EDDY was in top form when last seen in the spring and having gone well fresh before, Tom Gretton's 7-y-o gets the nod to pick up from where he left off. Jimmyjeroo was a bit laboured at Huntingdon last month but should reapplied cheekpieces spark him back to life, he's put forward as the main threat from a reduced mark. Glengolly and Brother Boris can fight out third. JUKEBOX D'EDDY (FR) JIMMYJEROO GLENGOLLY
race.bettingForecast: Jukebox D'eddy (9/4), Felton Bellevue (3/1), Subtle Fortune (11/2), Brother Boris (13/2), Glengolly (13/2), El Muchacho (10/1), Deadly Missile (20/1), Jimmyjeroo (20/1), Jo Lescribaa (50/1), Kadex (50/1)
